acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Ted was six when he first picked up a rock from the Petrified Forest National Park. Nearly 50 years later, he really wishes he hadn’t. Aviva DeKornfeld talked to him.
We first heard about this story from Ryan Thompson’s book Bad Luck, Hot Rocks.
acts.title: A Rock and a Hard Place

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Heavyweight host Jonathan Goldstein leaps in to help a family, who are not entirely sure they want or need his help, get rid of their stuff.
This story originally aired on the Heavyweight podcast.
acts.title: A Few Hundred of My Favorite Things
